about_the_game:
Demo Life/Death - ARPG in Cartoon setting.

A representative of office plankton accidentally gets into another world through a portal, where his skills lose relevance. He wants to return to his world, but does not know how to do so, as the beings capable of opening portals are not interested in helping him. In the process of driving out help from these "personalities", the hero drags into a global conflict between worlds.

Prolog is available in the Demo version of the game.

You have to evaluate the atmosphere, visual style and learn about how the main character will find himself in extremely unexpected circumstances that will lead him to meet with Death for the first time.

In this version of the game are available:

  • The first two locations,

  • Limited pool of skills,

  • Simplified feeding system,

  • A short list of available loot.

If you like the demo, add the game to your Wishlist and follow the updates.

short_description: Life/Death is a cartoon-style ARPG. An ordinary office worker who accidentally finds themselves in a magical and chaotic world filled with unicorns, wizards, living vegetables, and other fantasy and fusion-fantasy creatures.
supported_languages: English, Russian, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Japanese
